title: CLEAR x Zola Partnership: Say "I Do" to Seamless Travel
summary: CLEAR and Zola are partnering to offer newlyweds an exclusive CLEAR+ Wedding Package for seamless travel on all of life’s adventures, available through Zola Cash Funds.
body_markdown:
Sometimes the most meaningful wedding gift is an experience couples can share together.


That's why CLEAR and Zola are introducing the CLEAR+ Wedding Package, a new registry offering available through Zola Cash Funds. Friends and family can contribute toward a wedding gift that helps couples turn travel days into great days—starting with their honeymoon and continuing through a lifetime of trips together.


## **A Wedding Gift for All of Life’s Adventures**


The CLEAR+ Wedding Package helps newlyweds start their next chapter with a more enjoyable travel experience.


The package includes one year of CLEAR+ for the couple to enjoy seamless travel on all their adventures together, as well as exclusive access to CLEAR Concierge for a VIP airport experience when they fly.


Whether they're heading to their honeymoon, celebrating an anniversary, or planning their next romantic getaway, this is a gift they'll enjoy together long after the wedding day.


## **A Seamless Start to Life’s Next Chapter**


The honeymoon may be the first adventure after "I do," but it's only the beginning.


From holiday visits with family to spontaneous weekend getaways, travel days are an essential part of the memories couples build their lives around. The CLEAR+ Wedding Package helps them enjoy a stress-free airport experience, so they can focus on the moments that matter most.


With CLEAR+, Members unlock exclusive access to over 150 dedicated CLEAR+ Lanes where they can speed through airport security in seconds. With CLEAR Concierge, Members can enjoy a VIP travel day with a personal airport concierge who meets you at the curb when you arrive, helps you with bags and check-in, and brings you straight through security and to your gate or lounge.


## **A Meaningful Gift for Newlyweds**


More couples are choosing experiences alongside traditional registry gifts, and travel continues to be one of the best ways to start a new life together.


With the CLEAR+ Wedding Package available through Zola Cash Funds, friends and family can give couples something they'll truly cherish every time they embark on a new adventure—the gift of a seamless travel day.


This fall, CLEAR and Zola will introduce:


- The CLEAR+ Wedding Package through Zola Cash Funds
- Collaborative social content across CLEAR and Zola channels
- Cross-promotional email campaigns introducing the offering to engaged couples


Together, CLEAR and Zola are helping couples prepare for a lifetime of journeys ahead.
